Makita DJV186Z 18V top handle jigsaw delivers precise cutting performance across various materials using an 18V LXT battery system. Suitable for carpenters, kitchen fitters and general builders working on site, the powerful cordless tool handles demanding tasks with ease, delivering 370W maximum output. Variable speed trigger controls strokes from 0 to 2900spm for clean, controlled cuts, and 3 orbital settings plus straight cutting allow fast wood cutting up to 65mm deep. Features a rigid die-cast aluminium base, which bevels up to 45° for accurate angled joints. Also equipped with electronic brake to stop the blade quickly for safety, trigger lock function and and dust collection facility. Can be used with a dust nozzle to connect to a Makita vacuum cleaner to maintain a clean workspace. The lightweight design weighing only 1.6kg reduces user fatigue during prolonged use, whilst the soft grip enables comfortable use. Batteries, charger and dust nozzle sold separately.
